main_text.p: comedam donec expressero verba mea: qui dixit: loquere. Et ait: Serus sum Abraham. Et quidem Deus benedixit domino meo valde, & magnificatus est, dedit ꝗ illi oues & boues, argentum & aurum, seruos & ancillas, gamelos quoq; & asinos. Sed & Sara vxor domi ni mei peperit filium domino meo, post- quam ipsa consenuit: & dedit illi omnia quæ habet. Adiurauitq; me dominus meus dicens: Non accipies vxorem filio meo de filiabus Chananai, in cuius terra ego habito. Sed ad domum patris mei per ges, & ad cognationem meam, & accipi- es vxorem filio meo. Dixitq; ad dominū meum: Fortassis non ibit mulier post me. Et ille respondit mihi: Dominus, in cuius conspectu ambulo, mittet angelum suum tecum, & prosperum faciet iter tuum, ac cipiesq; vxorem filio meo de cognatione mea, & de domo patris mei. Tunc innocens eris à maledictione mea, cùm veneris ad cognationem meam: & si non dederint tibi, eris innocens à maledictione mea. Ego itaque veni hodie ad fontem, & dixi: Domine deus domini mei Abraham, si tu nunc prosperum facis iter meum,

page.notes: Catchword absent; the text ends with "meum," on a full line at the foot. Line-final "meum," is a full line, so it is kept as the last words of the paragraph. The first word "comedam" is a continuation from the previous page and is marked cont="true". Some letters are doubtful at the start of the page: "comedam" and "expressero" are clear. "dedit ꝗ illi" is printed as "dedit illi" with a q-abbreviation "dediẗq;" in the original, read as "dedit"+"q" joined to "illi"; the word "dedit" followed by "q;"-type mark over the t is transcribed here as "dedit" and the q-mark is ambiguous: "dedit[?]". The phrase "Dixitq" is printed as "Dixitq," with a comma after the abbreviation, and the comma is kept only as printed. Italic text is shown as roman because the page is set in italic type throughout; the text is a continuous paragraph of the printed page, with no paragraph indent visible at the top, and the final line ends without a paragraph break.
